svg.aria-label: STAR breakdown of the incident-command war-rooms story
svg.text: Story 05 · Incident command — war rooms (Atlassian) — STAR
Incident commander in 3 high-severity war rooms. One representative incident:
a service degraded, an availability SLA at risk. Info was incomplete + conflicting.
Run the room: drive rapid RCA + hotfix, restore service, hold the SLA.
Took command; separated investigation from communication + assigned roles.
Drove the RCA in parallel off the strongest signals, not serial guessing.
Made the call to RESTORE FIRST with a safe hotfix; tracked the permanent fix.
Held a calm, steady status cadence for responders and stakeholders.
Restored service and held the availability SLA [MTTR / figure — FILL IN].
Same playbook held across all 3: command · parallel RCA · restore-first · steady comms.
Signals: leadership under pressure · communication in crisis · ownership · calm decisions
Bracketed items are placeholders — fill in the real incident, MTTR and SLA figure before using.
